relationship: A line of best fit balances a paired-data cloud and supports estimates within the observed range without establishing causation.

learnerLoop.action: Drag the ruler through the data cloud and inspect a prediction.
learnerLoop.modelChange: The fitted line and its estimates move across the fixed observations.
learnerLoop.evidence: The point cloud, full-range ruler and range boundary distinguish supported estimates from extrapolation.
learnerLoop.nextDecision: Adjust the fit or decide whether the requested prediction is within the observed evidence.

invariants: A fitted line must represent the whole observed cloud rather than a selected pair of points.
Correlation can support an estimate but does not establish causation.
safeAdaptations: Vary paired datasets with visible observed ranges.
Adjust working support while preserving a learner-controlled line of best fit.
nonGoals: Presenting extrapolation or correlation as certain causal prediction.

task.description: Current generated dataset, prediction case and support level prompt.

model.description: Observed point cloud, draggable line of best fit, observed-range boundary and prediction probe.
model.visibility: Present throughout; range/probe elements vary by case.

working.description: Correlation choice, fit-balance checks, prediction and optional range/gap entries.
working.visibility: Generated working content follows the case and support level.

evidence.description: Whole-cloud fit evidence, correlation selection, range boundary and prediction/gap feedback expose what the data supports.
evidence.visibility: Evidence updates after line/probe changes and working checks.

completion.description: Solved case and next dataset or support upgrade.
completion.visibility: Shown only when the case-specific completion check passes.

settings.visibility: Support buttons are shown for the current case; some levels unlock after solved cases.

inputs.description: Generated correlation, prediction, range and extrapolation comparison entries.
inputs.visibility: Input slots appear only for the selected support and case phase.

observations.description: Paired x,y observations forming the entire point cloud.
observations.output: Point cloud and observed x-range boundary.

fit-line.description: Line position and tilt used to represent the whole cloud.
fit-line.output: Line, residual/balance evidence and fit readiness.

correlation-direction.description: Selected positive, negative, no-trend or case-appropriate correlation claim.

prediction.description: Predicted y at the generated query x, or inside/outside gap comparisons in extrapolation.
prediction.domain: Coordinate y value or gap values.
prediction.source: Probe position and generated working inputs when support is Some/All.
prediction.output: Probe label, prediction feedback and comparison cards.

observed-range.description: Lower and upper observed x limits used to distinguish interpolation from extrapolation.
observed-range.source: Point dataset; All support exposes range fields after a fit.

modes.none: Support 0 shows the fit and evidence while prediction/range answers are source-supplied.
modes.some: Support 1 requires the generated prediction or extrapolation comparison entries but keeps the observed range shown.
modes.all: Support 2 additionally requires the generated lower/upper observed-range entries.
modes.case-types: The source generates standard, zero-correlation and extrapolation cases; extrapolation requires two saved fits and an outside-range choice.

dependencies: A fit must satisfy the source's whole-cloud quality heuristic and the selected correlation direction before the standard case is fitReady.
Standard completion also requires the probe at the query and any selected support inputs; zero-correlation completion requires the no-trend choice.
Extrapolation requires saving a second distinct fit, seeing both inside and outside probe states, correct comparison work and choosing outside.
The next card appears only from isComplete(); support upgrades and next datasets are offered through that card.
implementation.completion: The source isComplete() check combines case-specific fit/probe/correlation conditions with support-gated working; when true, #nextCard is shown and the solved count may unlock a higher support level.
limitations: Fit quality and prediction use source tolerances/heuristics rather than a typed equation or exact statistical calculation.
Working inputs, correlation choices and range/gap cards are generated later under #workContent and do not all have stable IDs.
